subject: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As promised, attached is a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to the contracting path (MSA -> DPA -> Order Form) and (importantly) the evidence windows your procurement and privacy teams asked about. High level notes: 

- We propose a 3-week evaluation window (pilot) with a go/no-go checkpoint at the end of week 3.
- Legal sequencing: we can accept redlines to the MSA within a 7-business-day review window; DPA to follow once MSA terms are agreed (we can provision a data-subset pilot under a preliminary data-processing addendum if needed).
- Order Form (pricing/term length) will be finalized once acceptance criteria are met; procurement can execute via DocuSign.

Attachments: Northshore_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners) and a short annotated MSA (Redwood_MSA_annotated_v2.docx) showing our preferred concessions and the clauses we typically cannot change.

Can you confirm whether a 7-business-day MSA review window aligns with Northshore's procurement cycle? If not, please propose an alternative and we will try to accommodate.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Northshore_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated_v2.docx (document)
From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@northshorehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northshore Procurement <procure@northshorehealth.com>, Northshore Legal <legal@northshorehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot

Thanks, Marissa — the MAP is helpful. A few quick items from procurement/legal after a first pass: 

1) Procurement needs a 10-business-day window for MSA review because we run a parallel vendor questionnaire and need time to coordinate with our security team.
2) Legal flagged two DPA points that may require minor edits (data retention and subprocessors). They asked whether Redwood can provide a short evidence package (SOC2 summary + data-handling diagram) during the MSA review window.
3) For the pilot, we prefer an Order Form that limits data residency to us-east-1 and has a 30-day cancellation clause.

If you can accept a 10-business-day MSA review window and provide the SOC2 summary and a short architecture diagram, we can keep to the pilot schedule.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Digital Programs, Northshore Health
eruiz@northshorehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot

FYI — procurement is asking for a 10-business-day MSA window (not 7), and they want SOC2 summary + data-handling diagram during that review. Also explicit us-east-1 residency for the pilot and 30-day cancellation on Order Form. Can we accommodate without breaking our standard SLAs?

Suggested internal approach: 
- Accept 10-business-day MSA review window (we can move to 10 but ask for expedited review for later tiers).
- Laura: can your team assemble a concise evidence packet (SOC2 cover + 1-page architecture diagram) by Monday EOD?
- Karthik/Rishi: flag any MSA clauses that absolutely cannot be moved in 10 days. If legal needs to redline, propose a rapid-review cadence (we will accept up to 2 rounds of redlines within the 10-business-day window).

If we can confirm these, I'll update the MAP and respond.

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 10:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot

Marissa / team —

We can do the evidence packet. Plan: SOC2 summary (one page) + a one-page data-flow diagram that shows residency and limited subprocessors. Deliver by COB Monday (11 Oct).

On the MSA: the 10-business-day review window is acceptable. Two internal notes: 
- There are two MSA clauses that historically trigger extended review (indemnity cap and liability carve-outs for regulated data). If Northshore attempts broad expansions here, we'll need an extra business day to coordinate with legal ops, but that would be exceptional.
- For DPA, we will propose Redwood's standard subprocessors list and a retention schedule we can commit to for the pilot (30 days) and an extension path for production.

I'll prepare a short cover email and attach the evidence and an amended MAP that includes the new 10-business-day MSA window.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Cc: Northshore Procurement <procure@northshorehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lockstep playbook: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Northshore pilot

Elena —

Appreciate the quick feedback and the flexibility. Per our internal alignment: 

- We accept a 10-business-day review window for the MSA for this pilot.
- Laura has prepared the evidence packet (attached) — SOC2 one-pager and a data-residency diagram showing us-east-1 only.
- For DPA redlines, we will accept up to two rounds within the MSA review window and propose our standard retention schedule for the pilot (30 days).
- Order Form: we will draft a pilot Order Form that sets data residency to us-east-1 and includes a 30-day cancellation clause. Pricing on the Order Form will be provisional pending acceptance criteria at end of week 3.

Next steps: 
1) I have attached the updated MAP that reflects the 10-business-day MSA window and the pilot Order Form stub.
2) Laura will send the annotated MSA/DPA language if Northshore wants to redline; we ask that redlines be returned within 5 business days of receipt to stay on schedule.
3) If procurement is good, please sign the acknowledgement in the MAP and we'll kick off the pilot (target start: Mon, 18 Oct 2027).

Confirm when you're ready and I will send the DocuSign link for the Order Form stub.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Northshore_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated MAP with 10-business-day window)
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated_v2.docx (reference only)
